name: @fireworks-chen/dsh-desktop
description: Configurable Electron desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness
author: fireworks-chen

scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dir --arm64
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:backend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg --arm64
